name: smwmusic-tetris-blockorobeiniki-type-a-remix
title: Tetris - BlocKorobeiniki ~ Type A (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Type A from Tetris. Idk, but I thought it'd be a fun track to do a quick remix of, despite the many remixes of this song that exist (on this site and everywhere else).

This baby is great for bonus stages, boss fights, and any stages that have Tetrominoes in them.

Important:
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. A# Minor (Custom Pitch)
